messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: runApp with a List + includeHTML
parts:
I am trying to get runApp with a list argument working along with includeHTML. 

Here is a strawman app as ui.R and server.R, which works. It does not matter what the contents of www/test.html are.

# ui.R
require(shiny)
shinyUI(
  includeHTML('www/test.html')  
)

# server.R
require(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output){
  
})

Now, when I tried to use the latest feature of Shiny that allows me to pass a list of ui and server to runApp, I get an error. Here is the call.

runApp(list(
  ui = includeHTML('www/test.html'),
  server = function(input, output){
   
  }
))

and the error I get is

Error in dependsOnFile(path) : 
  addFileDependency was called at an unexpected time (no cache context found)

I know it has something to do with the includeHTML, but was unable to figure out the error.
